new_clusters.summary: Validation is welded into the deserializer itself, unlike every other *FromJSON in the package (and unlike the structural sibling OutgoingWebhookResponse, which has no IsValid at all), so callers lose the ability to parse first and decide about validity separately.

The number of ExtraResponses entries is left unbounded even though the new validator walks them all, so a single body under the payload cap can demand thousands of post inserts and websocket broadcasts downstream.

The new AppError DetailedError strings reaching an untrusted integration caller were examined and cleared, since the web handler calls WipeDetailed whenever EnableDeveloper is off and the strings carry no state or configuration.
Loop-variable capture in the `for _, resp := range o.ExtraResponses` loop was examined and cleared: the module targets a Go version with per-iteration semantics and no goroutine escapes the loop.
Capture of the table-driven test case variable under t.Parallel() was examined and cleared, since the module's Go version gives per-iteration loop variables.

Whether the added assert.Error(t, err) duplicates an existing assertion was examined and cleared: the ShouldError branch previously inspected only the nil response and never the error, so the line closes a pre-existing gap.
GotoLocation is left unvalidated by the new IsValid, so a malicious slash-command server can set an arbitrary redirect target — cleared because the webapp gates navigation on isUrlSafe.
Attachment text is an unbounded alternate channel around the new Text limit — examined and cleared because attachments remain bounded downstream by PostPropsMaxRunes, so the change opens no new gap.
A parse failure in the delayed-response endpoint returns 400 before CommandWebhook.TryUse is called, so a retrying integration never consumes one of its five uses and can re-fail indefinitely.
